## Agenda

- 19:30  Recap: Session 6
- 19:40  7.1  Protocol, ethics, consent, registration, feasibility
- 20:10  7.2  Research integrity: authorship, conflicts of interest, data sharing, AI
- 20:30  Proposal builder 7: ethics and publication plan
- 21:00  7.3  Writing the paper (I): IMRaD, Methods and Results
- 21:35  Manuscript workshop 1: the Results section, together then on your own

## Timetable

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 19:30 | 10 | Recap quiz |
| 0:10 | 19:40 | 30 | **7.1 Protocol, ethics and consent:** protocol (SPIRIT), Helsinki & GCP, ethics committee journey, registration, consent incl. ICU consent, confidentiality, feasibility |
| 0:40 | 20:10 | 20 | **7.2 Research integrity:** FFP, duplicate/salami, authorship, conflicts of interest, data sharing, AI use, scenario poll |
| 1:00 | 20:30 | 15 | **Proposal builder 7:** modelled live (ethics, registration, feasibility, publication plan), participants draft their own Part 4 as homework |
| 1:15 | 20:45 | 15 | BREAK |
| 1:30 | 21:00 | 35 | **7.3 Writing the paper (I): IMRaD, Methods and Results.** What each IMRaD section is for, writing order, Methods (design, participants, variables, statistics) and Results (participants first, numbers with CIs, no interpretation), stand-alone tables and figures, STROBE |
| 2:05 | 21:35 | 45 | **[DS] Manuscript workshop 1:** the class writes the Q1 Results together, then each participant starts the Results section for their chosen question, with Table 1 and one main table or figure from its results pack (finished as homework) |
| 2:50 | 22:20 | 10 | Key words, peer review and deadlines (your reviewer), wrap-up |

\*Times are relative to the start of the session; the clock column shows Vietnam time for the online 19:30–22:30 session. All exercises are done by the whole class together (no groups). **[DS]** = course-dataset content (FLUID-ICU analysis and manuscript writing).

## Before this session

- Proposal Part 3 finished. Slides started.
- Your chosen question (Q1 to Q5), its results pack, the [manuscript brief](manuscript-brief.qmd) and the manuscript template at hand for the manuscript workshop.

## After this session (homework)

- **Your proposal:** write Part 4 (Part B of the Session 7 sheet) and finish your 6 slides. To present in Session 8, email the instructor by the Wednesday before.
- **Your Results section:** write it for your question, as modelled on Q1 in class (Part C of the Session 7 sheet). It is due by 23:59 on Sunday 20 December 2026.
- Your reviewer is announced in this session and sent to you by email.
- Integrity scenarios 2, 5 and 6 on the Session 7 sheet.
